summary: First iteration end-to-end testing of Toko Lawanglimo (FastAPI + React + MongoDB). Backend: 20/20 pytest cases passed (health, auth incl. change-credentials with revert, categories CRUD, products CRUD with discount_code hiding on public endpoints + admin visibility, slides update, discount validate happy/invalid/empty, image upload + serve, auth-required gates). Frontend: home carousel + Belanja Sekarang nav, WA contact (wa.me/6281329856815) and Google Maps embed verified, shop add-to-cart updates Navbar cart-count, SPA navigation to /cart preserves items, discount code 'HEMAT10' applies (-Rp 10.000, total Rp 90.000), checkout-wa-btn opens correctly URL-encoded wa.me/6281329856815?text=... order details. Admin login + tabs (Produk/Kategori/Slider/Akun) functional; product create with image-less + discount fields works.

ui_bugs.issue: Cart items lost after hard browser refresh on /cart. The persistence writer useEffect([items]) fires on mount with the initial empty items=[] before the hydration useEffect's setItems propagates, briefly overwriting localStorage to '[]'. Although in theory a re-render should restore, in practice after page.reload() + 1.2s wait the cart was empty.

issues: React a11y console warning: 'Missing Description or aria-describedby={undefined} for DialogContent'. Add <DialogDescription> or aria-describedby to silence and improve accessibility.

action_items: Fix cart persistence race in /app/frontend/src/lib/cart.js. Recommended: initialise useState with a lazy initialiser that reads from localStorage synchronously (e.g. useState(() => JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('ll_cart_v1') || '[]'))) and drop the hydration useEffect. This eliminates the moment when items=[] is persisted before saved items are loaded.
Add DialogDescription (or aria-describedby) inside Add/Edit Product DialogContent to remove the a11y warning.
critical_code_review_comments: lib/cart.js – race condition between hydration useEffect and persistence useEffect (see action_items).
AdminPage.jsx is 498 lines – could be split into ProductsTab.jsx, CategoriesTab.jsx, SlidesTab.jsx, AccountTab.jsx for maintainability.
server.py uses deprecated @app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown') – consider migrating to lifespan context manager (FastAPI >=0.93).

Backend /api/discounts/validate finds any product matching code – if two products share the same code, only the first is returned. Consider enforcing unique discount_code at creation time or returning all matches.
Backend /api/files/{path} re-fetches from object storage on every request; consider Cache-Control headers for served images.

Frontend uploaded image URLs are stored as relative '/api/files/...'; resolveImageUrl handles this, but if REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL changes between admin upload and end-user view it still resolves correctly. OK.

success_rate.frontend: ~93% (1 high-priority cart persistence bug; rest working)

seed_data_creation: Created via UI: category 'TestCat-UI' and product 'UI Test Product' (price 100000, discount HEMAT10 10%). Backend pytest also creates TEST_* prefixed transient data and deletes within each test. UI-created seed product/category were NOT cleaned up (admin token had expired after reload); main agent or next iteration can delete via Admin > Produk if needed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests live in /app/backend/tests/test_lawanglimo_api.py (run: pytest backend/tests/test_lawanglimo_api.py -v). They auto-skip if admin/admin123 is no longer valid. WA number is 6281329856815. Discount code testing requires creating a product with discount_code first (since codes are stored on products). The cart race-bug is reproduced by: add item on /shop, navigate to /cart (works), then page.reload() – cart becomes empty.
rca of the issue: Cart persistence-after-reload bug RCA: In CartProvider, useEffect #1 reads localStorage and calls setItems(saved); useEffect #2 (dep=[items]) immediately runs on the same commit with the still-initial items=[] and writes '[]' to localStorage. Although a subsequent re-render restores it via the second pass of useEffect #2, Playwright still observed items=0 after reload+1.2s. Fix: use lazy useState initializer that synchronously hydrates from localStorage, removing the race window entirely.
